subject: environmental-science
title: Bycatch and Marine Protected Areas
welcome_lead: Non-target species die in the nets — and ocean reserves try to give the sea a rest.
meta_desc: A-Level Environmental Science adventure on bycatch, MPAs and selective gear.
final_note: MPAs are an insurance policy — and one of the few proven tools to rebuild biomass.

concepts.def: Non-target species caught incidentally; ~10% of global catch.
Area where extractive activities are restricted; ~8% of ocean.
Strictest MPA category prohibiting all fishing.
Adult migration from MPAs benefiting adjacent fisheries.
Turtle excluder device; metal grid in trawl reducing turtle bycatch.
Global commitment to protect 30% of land and sea by 2030 (CBD 2022).

walkthroughs.body_html: Pelagic longlines kill albatrosses; shrimp trawls kill turtles. Mitigation includes bird-scaring lines and TEDs.
No-take zones rebuild biomass 4× and species richness 21% on average (Lester et al. 2009).
The 2022 CBD framework targets 30% protection by 2030 — a leap from current ~8% ocean coverage.
